notches.note: Resonance measured at 3082 Hz, ~35 dB above the local spectrum, in 0.18s bursts. Not in the room and not in the raw SoX capture -- it appears only while the speaker is driven, so it is acoustic feedback (speaker to mic) excited by broadband traffic noise. A range rather than a point because it wanders: 3243 Hz on the first sighting, 3082 on the second. Provisional. The real fix is AEC so the speaker can stay live without a loop; remove this once that lands.
